description: NVIDIA engine class ids (bound with SET_OBJECT) and per-family method tables used by the pushbuffer decoder.

provenance.verified: Every class id is a '#define NAME (0x0000XXXX)' in an NVIDIA header (open-gpu-doc classes/ or open-gpu-kernel-modules sdk/nvidia/inc/class); 'source' names one such header (docs/research/NVIDIA_COMMAND_FACTS.md section 3.1). SEND_PCAS_A (0x2b4) and SEND_SIGNALING_PCAS_B (0x2bc) are defined identically from KEPLER_COMPUTE_A on. Host SEM_* (0x5c..0x6c) exist from VOLTA_CHANNEL_GPFIFO_A; earlier host classes use SEMAPHOREA..D.
provenance.method_names: Method names are the newest class's names; a few compute/host offsets are named differently in older classes (NVIDIA_COMMAND_FACTS.md section 8).
provenance.graphics_methods: 3d, 2d and video method names are the non-indexed method defines (a 0xNNNN offset with field sub-defines) of NVIDIA open-gpu-doc class headers at commit 9fdf5c406200: 3d = union of classes/3d/cl9097.h (FERMI_A), clc597.h (TURING_A), clc797.h (AMPERE_B), clc997.h (ADA_A) and clcd97.h (BLACKWELL_A), offsets named differently in older classes taking the newest name; 2d = classes/twod/cl902d.h (FERMI_TWOD_A, the only 2D class); video = only the methods that classes/video/clc7b0.h, clc9b0.h (NVDEC), clc7b7.h, clc9b7.h (NVENC) and clc9d1.h (NVJPG) define with the same name and offset, because one table serves every video class. Indexed (array) methods are not named.
